iconicAnchor.label: Saul Bass film graphics
iconicAnchor.whyCanonical: MoMA's collection connects Bass to major film posters, album graphics, and title-related screen design, establishing a recognized bridge between modern graphic form and cinema.

sources.title: Saul Bass
supports: Bass's film-related works establish strong display form, reduction, and screen-era graphic identity as a canonical title-design anchor.

sources.title: They Came From Within: B-Movie Title Design of the 1940s & 1950s
supports: Printed cards, optical effects, stop-frame animation, timed camera moves, and genre-specific typography shaped early title-sequence language.

bundledReferenceRationale: Excellent single-image set. The lead clearly teaches screen centered type, optical effects, film grain, leader marks, retains its identity at card scale, and shows no visible anti-cue, integrity failure, or confusing overlap with neighboring styles. The independently approved lead is assets/refs/analog-cinema-titles/generated-lead.jpg. No support image is needed because the lead carries the direction without filler.
